scope: Passive offline prerecorded RGB recognition; no runtime/control deployment
references: Prior hand-audited presence and custom1080 detection locations; not independent tight GT; IoU0.3 screening plus primary unmatched visual audit.
initial_case_timing_scope: Some initial screening runs overlapped the CPU motion experiment; use serial_gpu_timing for comparable descriptive latency, not each case wall fields.
primary_configuration_selection: 1280 single quadcopter prompt; 640/1280/1920 four-class runs and drone-only runs are sensitivity checks, not unseen validation.

manual_review.note: All primary unmatched frame panels inspected by root. Counts are reference-assisted presence screening, not independent mAP.

runtime_environment.scope: Same source aspect ratio; other tested detector heads also stride32; size is longestside, not square input.

serial_gpu_timing.input: 89 same original1920x1080 frames, in memory, batch1
serial_gpu_timing.scope: Local RTX5060 PyTorch wrapper latency, not NX latency, camera pipeline fps or time-to-first-detection.

serial_gpu_timing_current_generation.input: 89 same original1920x1080 frames, in memory, batch1
serial_gpu_timing_current_generation.scope: Local RTX5060 PyTorch wrapper latency, not NX latency, camera pipeline fps or time-to-first-detection.

phase.warp_border: constant; exclude pixels without full linear interpolation support

config.timing: Local CPU wall-clock per-frame algorithm+connectedComponents; decode/resize/common grayscale+float conversion separately timed and excluded. Shared preprocessing must be added for end-to-end interpretation; no NX benchmark.
config.scope: Foreground proposal diagnostics only. No semantic class, recall, precision, target identity or SVO alignment claims.

subsequent_label_audit_note: 2026-10-16 GLAD follow-up found 3 unresolved candidates in prior target_present=false frames. The 67 confirmed positives are not exhaustive ground truth; the other 22 frames are unreferenced, not proven negatives. Negative-condition and unmatched counters retain original labels, not semantic FP. See 2026-10-16-large-dataset-screening.json and companion report. All models require unified relabeling before formal recall/precision.
